sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.birthdate FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN encounters AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Outpatient Encounter'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.first FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN immunizations AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free'

SELECT DISTINCT T3.DESCRIPTION, T4.DESCRIPTION, T5.DESCRIPTION, T1.first, T1.last FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN encounters AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT INNER JOIN careplans AS T3 ON T1.patient = T3.PATIENT INNER JOIN procedures AS T4 ON T1.patient = T4.PATIENT INNER JOIN medications AS T5 ON T1.patient = T5.PATIENT WHERE T2.ID = '6f2e3935-b203-493e-a9c0-f23e847b9798'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN (julianday(T2.DATE)-julianday(T1.birthdate))/365 >= 20 AND (julianday(T2.DATE)-julianday(T1.birthdate))/365 < 30 THEN T2.VALUE ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(CASE WHEN (julianday(T2.DATE)-julianday(T1.birthdate))/365 >= 20 AND (julianday(T2.DATE)-julianday(T1.birthdate))/365 < 30 THEN T2.PATIENT END) - SUM(CASE WHEN (julianday(T2.DATE)-julianday(T1.birthdate))/365 >= 50 AND (julianday(T2.DATE)-julianday(T1.birthdate))/365 < 60 THEN T2.VALUE ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(CASE WHEN (julianday(T2.DATE)-julianday(T1.birthdate))/365 >= 50 AND (julianday(T2.DATE)-julianday(T1.birthdate))/365 < 60 THEN T2.PATIENT END) FROM patients T1 JOIN observations T2 ON T1.patient=T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION='Glucose'

SELECT T1.DESCRIPTION FROM conditions AS T1 INNER JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient WHERE T2.prefix = 'Mrs.' AND T2.first = 'Joye' AND T2.last = 'Homenick' AND substr(T1.START, 1, 4) = '2017'

SELECT T1.DATE FROM immunizations AS T1 INNER JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient WHERE T2.prefix = 'Mrs.' AND T2.first = 'Joye' AND T2.last = 'Homenick' AND T1.DESCRIPTION = 'Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free' ORDER BY T1.DATE DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.PATIENT), T2.DESCRIPTION FROM encounters AS T1 INNER JOIN careplans AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Second degree burn' AND T2.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Second degree burn' GROUP BY T2.DESCRIPTION
SELECT DISTINCT T1.DESCRIPTION FROM medications AS T1 INNER JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient WHERE T2.first = 'Joye' AND T2.last = 'Homenick'

SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN T1.deathdate IS NULL THEN (julianday(substr(datetime('now'), 1, 10)) - julianday(T1.birthdate)) / 365 ELSE (julianday(T1.deathdate) - julianday(T1.birthdate)) / 365 END) FROM patients AS T1 WHERE T1.gender = 'M' AND T1.patient IN (SELECT PATIENT FROM conditions WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'Hypertension')
